_meta.purpose: Domain-level tier rulings for the AFRIK corpus. The authorized-source-catalog covers the 38 domains an editor may cite deliberately; this file covers the 801 domains the corpus already cites, so the classification pass can resolve them without a per-citation decision.
_meta.doctrine: See CLAUDE.md, Source Tier Policy. Nothing is forbidden; everything is labelled. official = 1.0, referenced = 0.7, unverified = 0.4.
_meta.precedence: authorized-source-catalog.json wins where a domain appears in both. A domain absent from both resolves to needs_review, never to a silent guess.
_meta.borderline: An entry marked borderline:true is a judgement call that an editor should confirm. It is applied, not deferred — but it is the shortlist to re-read first.
_meta.coverage: 353 domains, 3530 of the corpus's 3945 URL-bearing citations at the time of writing.
